summary.text: T.J. Brown is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 27 (Horace), serving since 2025. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Government and Veterans Affairs and Industry, Business and Labor.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Brown is an entrepreneur and an Army veteran.
In the interim he serves on the Judiciary Committee and the Protection and Victim Services Committee.
His biography lists him as married, with three children.
